name: Van Clad
source:
The captain of a large pirate crew who was known as the Pirate King 300 years ago and was said to be the strongest and most ruthless pirate in the world. He has a very cruel personality and is a hardened hedonist. He was betrayed by one of his subordinates, the man who went on to became the first king of the Kingdom of Austria. He is killed in a deceitful manner, but his spirit lives on with the grudge. By chance, he gains a new body and is revived in the pressent time.
